definitions.explanation: Financial gain from business activities; the difference between revenue and costs.
Something that is advantageous or good.

notes:
USAGE: {利益|りえき} is commonly used in business contexts for profit, and in broader contexts for benefits or interests.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {利益|りえき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧ (to make a profit)
- {利益|りえき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{追求|ついきゅう}→追求：14401_tsuikyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to pursue profit)
- {利益|りえき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧ (to protect interests)
- ⟦{純|じゅん}→純：noentry⟧{利益|りえき} (net profit)
- ⟦{営業|えいぎょう}→営業：01878_eigyou⟧{利益|りえき} (operating profit)
- ⟦{公共|こうきょう}→公共：11652_koukyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{利益|りえき} (public interest)
